item.title: Federal Changes Will Put Hemp Industry Operators Out Of Business, Oregon Retailers And Suppliers Say
item.dc:creator: Marijuana Moment
item.description:
“The proposed federal definition would wipe out most of the products on our shelves.”

The post Federal Changes Will Put Hemp Industry Operators Out Of Business, Oregon Retailers And Suppliers Say appeared first on Marijuana Moment.
item.content:encoded:
Oregon hemp retailers and suppliers told state lawmakers this week that a pending federal redefinition of hemp would force most of them to close.

“The proposed federal definition would wipe out most of the products on our shelves,” one store owner testified at the joint committee hearing.

The change, attached to a spending bill, would cap total THC per container. Industry groups estimate that it would affect the majority of intoxicating hemp products now sold in the state.

item.title: Pennsylvania Senate Committee Advances Marijuana Legalization Bill After Bipartisan Deal
item.dc:creator: Kyle Jaeger
item.description: The bill now heads to the full Senate.
item.content:encoded:
A Pennsylvania Senate committee voted 9–5 on Friday to advance a bill that would legalize marijuana for adults 21 and older and set up state-licensed retail sales.

The bill now heads to the full Senate.
